zh.title: 捷藍航空將從羅德岱堡開航大開曼及宏都拉斯 每日各一班
zh.summary: 捷藍航空已開賣羅德岱堡飛往大開曼與宏都拉斯帕爾梅羅拉機場的直飛航班，兩條航線將於2027年2月下旬先後開航。
body: 捷藍航空（JetBlue）11月19日宣布，將從佛州羅德岱堡－好萊塢國際機場（FLL）增開兩條每日直飛航線。大開曼喬治敦的歐文羅伯茨國際機場（GCM）將於2027年2月23日開航，宏都拉斯科馬亞瓜的帕爾梅羅拉國際機場（XPL）則於2月25日開航。兩條航線均已開賣，仍須取得營運許可。
帕爾梅羅拉機場服務宏都拉斯首都德古西加巴，這將是捷藍航空在宏都拉斯的第二個航點，補充現有的羅德岱堡－聖佩德羅蘇拉航線。公司規劃使用空中巴士A320與A220執飛這兩條新航線。
捷藍航空另安排2027年1月29日至2月15日每日由羅德岱堡直飛千里達及托巴哥首都西班牙港。公司預計，到2027年2月底，從羅德岱堡直飛的國際航點將達20個。

en.title: JetBlue to add daily Fort Lauderdale flights to Grand Cayman and Honduras
en.summary: JetBlue has opened bookings for new nonstop flights from Fort Lauderdale to Grand Cayman and Honduras’s Palmerola International Airport. Both routes are due to start in late February 2027.
body: JetBlue announced two new daily nonstop routes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) on November 19. Flights to Owen Roberts International Airport (GCM) on Grand Cayman are due to start on February 23, 2027. Flights to Palmerola International Airport (XPL) in Comayagua, Honduras, will follow on February 25. Both are on sale and remain subject to government approval.

Palmerola serves the Honduran capital, Tegucigalpa, and will be JetBlue’s second destination in the country alongside San Pedro Sula. The airline plans to use Airbus A320 and A220 aircraft on the new routes.

JetBlue also plans daily seasonal service from Fort Lauderdale to Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago, from January 29 through February 15, 2027. It expects to serve 20 international destinations nonstop from Fort Lauderdale by the end of February.

zh.title: 美國陸軍以無人地面載具發射18架無人機
zh.summary: 美國陸軍在德國實彈展示中，以無人地面載具發射18架小型無人機。
body: 美國陸軍11月12日在德國的 Grafenwoehr Training Area 訓練場舉行實彈技術展示。影片顯示，R3NEGADE無人地面載具發射由18架小型第一人稱視角（FPV）無人機組成的機羣。
美國陸軍表示，展示旨在評估新興無人空中與地面能力。實彈過程中，TRV-150無人機向目標投放煙霧。一組無人機從安裝在R3NEGADE上的HIV3機羣發射器發射。
報導指出，無人機對目標進行自主打擊，士兵也參與FPV無人機的操作環節。

en.title: US Army unmanned ground vehicle launches 18-drone swarm
en.summary: US Army launches 18 drones from an unmanned ground vehicle during a live-fire demonstration in Germany.
body: The US Army conducted a live-fire technology demonstration at Grafenwoehr Training Area in Germany on November 12. A video showed its R3NEGADE unmanned ground vehicle launching a swarm of 18 small first-person-view (FPV) drones.

The Army said the demonstration was intended to evaluate emerging unmanned air and ground capabilities. During the live-fire sequence, a TRV-150 drone dropped smoke onto a target. A group of drones was launched from the HIV3 swarm drone launcher mounted on the R3NEGADE.
The drones carried out autonomous strikes on the target, with soldiers in the loop for the FPV drones.

zh.title: 土耳其接收首批三架 Baykar Kızılelma 無人戰機
zh.summary: Baykar 表示，首批三架 Kızılelma 無人戰機完成驗收測試，並於11月19日交付土耳其安全部隊。
body: 土耳其航空製造商 Baykar 宣佈，首批三架 Kızılelma 無人戰機完成驗收測試，已於11月19日交付土耳其安全部隊。公司表示，這批飛機交付後即正式列裝。
Kızılelma 由 Baykar 開發。公司在2021年7月公開概念圖，2022年3月開始生產，原型機於同年12月14日完成首飛。這次交付距原型機首飛將近四年。
依 Baykar 說法，交付前，整個計畫的測試與訓練飛行累計已達600架次。這次公佈的交付數量為三架，公告未提供下一批交付日期。

en.title: Türkiye receives first three Baykar Kızılelma uncrewed fighter jets
en.summary: Baykar says the aircraft passed acceptance tests and were handed over to Turkish security forces on November 19.
body: Turkish aircraft manufacturer Baykar said it delivered the first three Kızılelma uncrewed fighter jets to Turkish security forces on November 19. The aircraft had completed their acceptance tests, and the company said they entered service upon delivery.

Baykar first disclosed concept images in July 2021 and began production in March 2022. The prototype made its maiden flight on December 14 that year, nearly four years before the initial aircraft were delivered.

Baykar said test and training flights across the programme had reached a cumulative total of 600 sorties. The announcement covered the handover of the first three aircraft and did not give a date for another delivery.

facts.claim: The first three Kızılelma aircraft completed acceptance tests and were delivered on November 19, 2026.
The type first flew on December 14, 2022.
Baykar reported 600 test and training sorties across the programme.

zh.title: 好萊塢伯班克機場塔臺一度無人值勤 飛行員以無線電協調降落
zh.summary: 當地媒體報導，好萊塢伯班克機場11月18日晚間一度失去塔臺服務，進場飛行員改用共同交通諮詢頻率協調。
body: 美國加州好萊塢伯班克機場（BUR）11月18日晚間一度沒有航管員在塔臺值勤。據 MyNewsLA 刊載的報導，通訊錄音顯示，航管員曾向飛行員通報塔臺即將進入「ATC Zero」狀態，隨後停止通訊。
在塔臺服務暫停期間，進場航機改用共同交通諮詢頻率，由飛行員透過無線電互相通報並協調降落。這項措施讓飛行員在塔臺無法提供服務時掌握彼此動態。
MyNewsLA 於11月19日報導，塔臺預計在當天恢復正常作業。機場當時未提供更多資訊，公開報導也未確認此次服務中斷持續多久。

en.title: Hollywood Burbank tower loses controller coverage; pilots coordinate arrivals by radio
en.summary: Pilots switched to a common advisory frequency during a tower service interruption on November 18.
body: Hollywood Burbank Airport (BUR) in California briefly had no controller on duty in its tower on the evening of November 18, according to a report carried by MyNewsLA. Audio from the tower frequency captured a controller advising pilots that the facility was going to “ATC Zero” before transmissions ended.
Incoming pilots switched to the common traffic advisory frequency to communicate with one another and coordinate landings while tower service was unavailable.

MyNewsLA reported on November 19 that normal tower operations were expected to resume that day. The airport did not provide further information for the report, and the exact length of the interruption was unclear.

facts.claim: The tower had no controller on duty on November 18 and an ATC Zero announcement was heard on the tower frequency.
Incoming pilots switched to a common advisory frequency to coordinate landings.
Tower operations were expected to return to normal on November 19.

zh.title: 波音 B-1B 轟炸機升級案通過關鍵設計審查
zh.summary: 波音表示，B-1B 轟炸機的外掛系統升級案已通過關鍵設計審查，將進入製造、整合與測試的準備階段。
body: 波音11月17日宣布，美國空軍 B-1B「槍騎兵」轟炸機的外掛系統升級案已通過關鍵設計審查。波音表示，美國空軍的 B-1 專案辦公室已接受設計，並確立後續開發所依據的設計基準。
按照波音公布的進度，團隊接下來將為製造、系統整合與測試做準備。這項升級屬於美國空軍的轟炸機現代化工作，波音此次公告聚焦在審查結果及下一階段工作。
依波音機型資料，B-1B 自1985年起在美國空軍服役，波音至今仍與空軍合作維持機隊並執行現代化計畫。

en.title: Boeing’s B-1B bomber upgrade clears critical design review
en.summary: Boeing says a B-1B modernization project has passed critical design review and will move into preparations for manufacturing, integration and testing.
body: Boeing announced on November 17 that its external carriage upgrade for the U.S. Air Force’s B-1B Lancer had passed critical design review. The Air Force’s B-1 program office accepted the design and established a baseline for further development, the company said.
The project now moves to preparations for manufacturing, integration and testing. The review is one milestone in the Air Force’s broader modernization effort for its bomber fleet.
The B-1B has served with the U.S. Air Force since 1985. Boeing continues to work with the Air Force on fleet sustainment and modernization.
